headline_marked: US arrests [[influencer Andrew Tate and brother]] in extradition case
headline: US arrests influencer Andrew Tate and brother in extradition case
summary: The pair were detained in Miami as Britain seeks their extradition to face charges of rape, sex trafficking, and assault.
details: Radical social media influencer Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan were taken into custody in the US, officials confirmed yesterday.
The arrests took place in Miami on Saturday, where law enforcement officers placed the siblings in handcuffs and escorted them into vehicles.
The US Marshals Service confirmed the detentions, which are pending ongoing legal proceedings.
Britain is currently seeking the extradition of the Tate brothers to face serious charges including rape, sex trafficking, and assault.
Andrew Tate is a self-professed misogynist known for his controversial social media presence and global influence.
caption:
Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan have been arrested in Miami.

Radical social media influencer Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan were taken into custody in the US, officials confirmed yesterday.

The arrests took place in Miami on Saturday, where law enforcement officers placed the siblings in handcuffs and escorted them into vehicles.

The US Marshals Service confirmed the detentions, which are pending ongoing legal proceedings.

Britain is currently seeking the extradition of the Tate brothers to face serious charges including rape, sex trafficking, and assault.
